items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the property of being a thickening of algebraic spaces is fpqc local on the target, and likewise for first order thickenings (statement lines 1967-1968). The proof follows the same two-ingredient pattern as its scheme-level counterpart but has to use the descent statement for algebraic spaces: joint surjectivity of the covering gives surjectivity of X -> X', descent of the closed-immersion property over algebraic spaces makes X -> X' a closed immersion, and a surjective closed immersion is by definition a thickening (proof lines 1976-1980). The author explicitly leaves the first order case unproved, and that sentence is reproduced as written. The claim is H2: short, one reduction, no construction of its own.
